title: MarketRadar Module 1 Lint Summary Quality Rubric

dimensions.name: Lint Result Accuracy
dimensions.description: Does the summary correctly report whether the lint command passed or failed and accurately connect that claim to the recorded command result?

levels.1: Incorrectly reports lint success or failure.
levels.2: Mentions lint outcome ambiguously or incompletely.
levels.3: Clearly and correctly reports lint pass/fail.
levels.4: Correct outcome supported by specific command and result evidence.

examples.1: Says lint passed when the command exited nonzero.
examples.2: Says 'There were some issues' without stating pass or fail.
examples.3: Says 'Lint failed' when the recorded command failed.
examples.4: Says 'npm run lint failed (exit 1)' and cites the relevant output.

dimensions.name: Error and Warning Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the summary cover significant errors and warnings in the recorded lint output without omissions or invented issues?

levels.1: Misses major errors or warnings or invents success.
levels.2: Mentions some issues but omits significant others.
levels.3: Covers all important errors and warnings evidenced by the command output.
levels.4: Comprehensive coverage, grouped or prioritized for easy review.

examples.1: Claims no errors although ESLint reported multiple errors.
examples.2: Mentions one warning but ignores two errors.
examples.3: Lists each important ESLint error and warning.
examples.4: Separates errors from warnings and highlights blocking errors first.

dimensions.name: Recommendation Quality
dimensions.description: Is the recommended next step appropriate, actionable, and proportionate to the recorded lint findings?

levels.1: Recommends proceeding despite failing lint without acknowledging risk.
levels.2: Offers vague advice disconnected from specific findings.
levels.3: Recommends an appropriate next action consistent with the results.
levels.4: Provides clear, ordered, actionable next steps and a re-verification command.

examples.4: Says 'resolve unused imports, rerun npm run lint, then resume the build.'
